origin: Adapted arithmetic from the historical gesundheit.inc calculator, lines 443–561. Not study-derived effect estimates.

bmi.interpretation: Our experimental mapping, not a published or validated mortality coefficient. Replaces the old BMI correction. Central range is neutral; correction scales with official remaining life expectancy, without a second age multiplier.

adaptations: Smoking dose is required for a current-smoker adjustment; missing quantities are unknown.
The former-smoker bonus requires more than five years since quitting.
Unknown inputs contribute no adjustment and are reported as unknown, not healthy.
Daily fruit/vegetables, activity frequency and alcohol portions follow the old questions, not the 2014 study categories.
The coefficients and limits are heuristic choices, not validated personal or causal effects.

Weight correction uses age- and sex-specific SBMI instead of fixed BMI cutoffs. Central 30–39 is neutral; each point outside subtracts 0.4% of official remaining years up to 8%. No additional BMI correction, age multiplier or central-range bonus.
